<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;
typedef uint64_t u64;
const u64 N = 300000 + 5;
const u64 MOD = 1000000007;
u64 mpow(u64 x, u64 n) {
	u64 res = 1;
	while (n) {
		if (n & 1) res = res * x % MOD;
		x = x * x % MOD;
		n >>= 1;
	}
	return res;
}
u64 dp[27][N];
u64 rf[N];
u64 f[N];
u64 permute(u64 n, u64 m) {
	return f[n] * rf[n - m] % MOD;
}
int main() {
	u64 n, K;
	cin >> n >> K >> MOD;
	if (n & 1) {
		cout << mpow(K, n) << endl;
		return 0;
	}
	f[0] = 1;
	for (u64 i = 1; i <= n; ++ i) f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % MOD;
	rf[n] = mpow(f[n], MOD - 2);
	for (u64 i = n - 1; i >= 0; -- i) rf[i] = rf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD;
	dp[0][0] = 1;
	for (u64 k = 0; k < K; ++ k) {
		for (u64 i = 1; i <= n; ++ i) {
			if ((i & n) != i) continue;
			u64 cnt = 0;
			u64 &res = dp[k + 1][i];
			u64 hb = (1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(i)));
			for (u64 j = i - hb; j >= 0; j = (j - 1) & i) {
				u64 jj = j + hb;
				res += dp[k][i ^ jj] * rf[jj];
				if (cnt ++ == 17) {
					res %= MOD;
					cnt = 0;
				}
				if (j == 0) break;
			}
			res %= MOD;
		}
	}
	u64 ans = 0;
	for (u64 i = 0; i <= K; ++ i) (ans += f[n] * dp[i][n] % MOD * permute(K, i) % MOD) %= MOD;
	cout << (mpow(K, n) + MOD - ans) % MOD << endl;
}
